prompt.project_info: Create a wholesome, candid romantic moment inside a premium car for social media.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult man and one generic approved adult woman seated together in a beige car interior. The man in a navy T-shirt and sunglasses gently kisses the woman's hand; she wears a white tank top under a light blue-and-white striped shirt and looks toward the camera with a relaxed smile.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical selfie-style framing from inside the car, both adults clearly visible from the waist up. Include the panoramic sunroof, beige seats, phones resting on the center console, palm trees, and modern buildings outside the windows. Keep the hand-kiss as a simple affectionate gesture.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright natural daytime light filtered through the sunroof and windows, warm beige interior, clean urban holiday atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic vertical UGC phone photo, natural skin texture, realistic hands and faces, mild smartphone perspective, no readable branding or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical UGC phone photo of one generic approved adult man and one generic approved adult woman seated together in a beige premium car interior, the man in a navy T-shirt and sunglasses gently kissing her hand, the woman in a white tank top with a light blue-and-white striped shirt smiling naturally at the camera, panoramic sunroof, beige seats, phones on the center console, palm trees and modern buildings outside, bright natural daytime light, wholesome affectionate candid mood, realistic anatomy and hands, no logos, no watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, fetish styling, nudity, minors, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, coercive gesture, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed hands, duplicate subject, unreadable text, logos, watermark

assets.name: romantic-hand-kiss-in-car reference
assets.usage: Match the affectionate hand-kiss gesture, two-person selfie composition, wardrobe categories, car interior, and bright urban setting while keeping both identities generic and replaceable.
